items.q: Farley and Raleigh, who were in the Onyx at this time

ctx.x: Then Dick Stabile come to hear us and we Farley and Raleigh, who were in the Onyx at this time, they were getting ready to leave to go to California to make a picture, a moving picture, since they had just made a hit record called, 'You Blow Through Here,' 'The Music Goes Down and Around and Comes out There.' So they were leaving, so Dick Stabile told Stuff, 'This would be the very group to follow Farley and Raleigh in the Onyx Club.' So he said, 'We're going to have them come down and take a listen to you.' He…

know. You have so many promises down through life. You get so it just goes in one ear and out the other. So, sure enough, they set it up. The guy come down to listen to us, and they said all right, on the 4th of February you open. Well, this is about December, or November, it could have been, the last part of November, the first part of December, and they were setting this up.
